pluss::subsp::stats::ts::var_to_vecm¶

Converts the lag matrices of a VAR into the short-run matrices and the impact matrix of its error-correction form.

Signature¶

std::pair<pluss::Series, pluss::Series> ts::var_to_vecm(const pluss::Series& ar, pluss::codem::Config cfg = {});

What It Does¶

A VAR(p) y_t = A_1 y_{t−1} + … + A_p y_{t−p} + e_t can be rewritten as Δy_t = y_{t−1} Π + Σ Γ_i Δy_{t−i} + e_t with Π = A_1 + … + A_p − I (the impact) and Γ_i = −(A_{i+1} + … + A_p). var_to_vecm returns (short_run, impact) for the lag array of a VarFit in the same row-vector layout. A rank-deficient impact matrix means the series are cointegrated.

Parameters¶

const pluss::Series& ar

The lag matrices, a p × k × k array.

pluss::codem::Config cfg

Output configuration (dtype and platform of the returned series).

Returns¶

A pair: the short-run matrices ((p − 1) × k × k) and the impact matrix (k × k).

Practical Examples¶

Example 1¶

Convert the VAR(2) of two linked series and convert back; the round trip reproduces the coefficients.

#include <pluss/ma.h>

#include <cmath>
#include <iomanip>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

namespace ts = pluss::subsp::stats::ts;
using pluss::Series;

const auto f64 = pluss::Config{}.with_dtype(pluss::ScalarType::Float64);
void show(const char* label, const Series& s) {
  std::cout << std::left << std::setw(14) << label << std::right << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4);
  for (double v : s.host<double>()) std::cout << std::setw(9) << v;
  std::cout << "\n";
}
std::vector<double> noise(int n, int offset) {
  std::vector<double> e(n);
  for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
    double u = std::sin(12.9898 * (i + offset + 1.0) + 78.233) * 43758.5453;
    u -= std::floor(u);
    e[i] = u - 0.5;
  }
  return e;
}
// Two linked series: a_t = 0.5 a_{t-1} + 0.2 b_{t-1} + e1_t,  b_t = 0.1 a_{t-1} + 0.6 b_{t-1} + 0.5 e1_t + e2_t   (n x 2, row t = (a_t, b_t)).
Series linked(int n) {
  const auto e1 = noise(n, 0), e2 = noise(n, 5000);
  std::vector<double> y(2 * n);
  double a = 0.0, b = 0.0;
  for (int t = 0; t < n; ++t) {
    const double na = 0.5 * a + 0.2 * b + e1[t];
    const double nb = 0.1 * a + 0.6 * b + 0.5 * e1[t] + e2[t];
    a = na;
    b = nb;
    y[2 * t] = a;
    y[2 * t + 1] = b;
  }
  return pluss::make_series(y, {n, 2}, f64);
}

int main() {
  const Series y = linked(300);
  ts::VarOptions options;
  options.lag_order = 2;
  const auto fit = ts::Var::fit_mle(y, options);
  const auto [short_run, impact] = ts::var_to_vecm(fit.ar);
  const Series back = ts::vecm_to_var(short_run, impact);
  std::cout << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4) << "impact row 0: " << impact.select(0, 0).host<double>()[0] << " " << impact.select(0, 0).host<double>()[1] << "\n";
  std::cout << "largest difference after the round trip: " << std::scientific << std::setprecision(1) << (back - fit.ar).abs().max().item<double>() << "\n";
}

Output

impact row 0: -0.5153 0.1763
largest difference after the round trip: 0.0e+00
